meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Flask/Django/FastAPI 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux;缺资源时自动建资源组、Plan 和 Web App,部署完打印消息并结束,不做部署后验证。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”、“FastAPI App Service”等关键词时触发。非 Python、IaC、完整基础设施不适用。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 项目部署到 Azure App Service Linux
say.note: 缺少的资源组、Plan、Web App 会自动创建

say.text: 这是 FastAPI 项目,帮我部署到 App Service
say.note: 会先设置 uvicorn 启动命令再部署

say.text: 用 azd 把当前 Django 项目部署到 App Service
say.note: 检测到 azure.yaml 时走 azd 部署路径

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude deploys Flask/Django/FastAPI Python code to Azure App Service Linux, creating the RG, Plan and Web App if missing, then prints a post-deploy message and ends the turn (no post-deploy checks).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service" or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python or IaC.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service Linux
say_en.note: Missing RG, Plan and Web App are created

say_en.text: This is a FastAPI project — deploy it to App Service
say_en.note: Sets the uvicorn startup command, then deploys

say_en.text: Use azd to deploy the current Django project to App Service
say_en.note: Takes the azd path when azure.yaml is present
